change: Filled a nonblocking TCP send buffer, half-closed the peer write side, then compared epoll interest masks.
evidence: Executable socket test observed RDHUP on three repeated waits with OUT|RDHUP, and no events over a 20ms wait after changing to OUT alone. This reproduces the event-loop mechanism, not a full-server load measurement.
hypothesis: A write-stalled connection with read-side half-close can spin on repeated level-triggered RDHUP notifications.
next_action: Submit one-change write-interest snapshot and run public suite and fresh-start validation.
verdict: Risk confirmed in bounded test; write-mode interest can omit RDHUP without suppressing OUT.
